  • not hosting a mod doesn't mean that mod won't be available
  • they're within their rights to curate what mods they want to host BUT
  • we're also within our rights to criticize their decision or decide not to support them because of it

Personally I don't think hosting a mod is an endorsement of that mod, but it sounds like Paradox is afraid of that connection. That's within their rights, but I'm not a fan of pulling anything for political reasons because it's unfair to the mod's creators and because it opens up a big can of worms for Paradox: now that they've established that they're pulling mods they don't like, people can fairly assume that anything left up is something that they DO like and approve of.
